Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Innovative Tech Solutions LLC specializes in providing a wide range of computer and technology services, including software development, IT consulting, and systems integration. Our operations include designing custom software solutions tailored to client needs, implementing cybersecurity measures, and offering technical support for various hardware and software products. We maintain strict data security protocols, including data encryption, regular employee training on cybersecurity best practices, and robust backup systems to protect client data. Our team is dedicated to delivering high-quality services while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. Additionally, we do not utilize cloud-based accounting software to maintain the integrity of our financial data.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2023, we experienced a data breach due to a phishing attack that compromised a client’s sensitive information. We incurred $10,000 in expenses for forensic investigation and legal consultation. The incident was reported to affected clients, and we implemented additional cybersecurity training for all employees. The breach is currently resolved, and we have taken steps to enhance our cybersecurity measures. Additionally, on June 15, 2022, we had a technical failure in our software that resulted in $5,000 in client reimbursement for service interruption. This loss has been settled.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Business Operations: Confirm the exact nature of services provided. Firms engaged solely
in bookkeeping or tax preparation may have different risk profiles than those offering invest-
ment advice or financial planning.
• Professional Liability Coverage: Verify whether the applicant maintains separate pro-
fessional liability insurance. Absence of such coverage should prompt referral to a specialty
underwriter or require additional risk mitigation measures.
• Data Security Measures: Assess the firm’s cybersecurity protocols, including data en-
cryption, employee training, and backup systems. Strong controls reduce the likelihood and
impact of cyber incidents.
• Premises and Equipment Values: Ensure accurate valuation of office contents and prop-
erty to avoid underinsurance.
• Claims History: Review prior claims related to errors, omissions, data breaches, or general
liability incidents.
